description: Recovers database connection issues by patching memory limits and restarting the deployment.
Handles pod OOMKilled events by increasing memory limits and restarting the affected deployment.
Restarts unhealthy deployments that fail liveness/readiness probes, with rollback if restart fails.
Scales up worker replicas when message queue backlog exceeds threshold via GitOps deferred path.
Rotates expiring secrets/certificates before they cause service disruption.
